summary: StudentEmploymentApplication is a web page and code-behind for submitting a student employment application in HSPnet. It presents application details, manages document uploads, handles placement history, and manages submission workflows including email notifications to recruitment contacts. Controls are organized in tabbed panels for Documents and Placement History. The application is editable by students or system administrators unless withdrawn. Submission triggers backend logic and email notifications.
purpose: To allow students or authorized staff to submit employment applications, manage supporting documents, view placement history, and send notifications to recruitment contacts.

workflows.name: Submission
steps: User loads employment application page (with ID in query string)
Application data is fetched and bound to header
Visibility of controls decided (submit panel, release history, etc.)
User selects to release placement history and submits
EmploymentApplications.Submit is called with session, application ID, and release history flag
If no errors, recruitment contact email is looked up
Templates for subject and body are loaded
Email template fields (e.g., SiteName) are merged
Email is sent to Recruitment Contact
Warnings or errors about email sending are shown as messages

workflows.name: Documents Tab Workflow
steps: EmploymentApplicationDocuments and StudentDocumentSelector are initialized and bound with session and IDs
Documents grid is displayed and editable if allowed

workflows.name: Placement History Tab Workflow
steps: TabPanelPlacementHistory is enabled only if ReleaseHistory is set
WelcomeStudentPRHistory user control is initialized and bound

business_rules: Screen is editable only if not withdrawn and user is system administrator or student ID matches staff ID
Submit panel is visible if staff ID equals student ID
ReleaseHistory checkbox controls visibility of placement history tab
If RecruitmentContactEmail is empty, warning is shown
Email template fields are replaced with real values before sending
validations: UserSession hash is validated on page load
EmploymentApplication ID is parsed and used as key
Email format is checked before sending
conditions: TabPanelPlacementHistory is enabled if _data.ReleaseHistory is true
Controls visibility depend on UserSession and ScreenIsEditable
IsPostBack decides if ReleaseHistory is checked and which tab is activated
system_behavior: Show/hide error and warning panels via client-side script
Resize window to fixed size on page render
Bind document and placement history grids
dependencies: Templates for email subject and body
exceptions: No Recruitment Contact: warning shown, no email sent
Email send failure: error message shown
content_gaps: Underlying field definitions and business logic for controls (e.g., EmploymentApplications, Templates) are referenced but not detailed in retrieved content.
Some user controls and templates are included by reference only, their internal behavior is not analyzed here.
